_meta.source: HUD CY2026 FHA forward mortgage limits: https://apps.hud.gov/pub/chums/cy2026-forward-limits.txt
_meta.naming_convention: County keys are the OFFICIAL name exactly as published in the source file (FHFA CSV spelling, which is upper-case for counties/parishes/boroughs and mixed-case for Connecticut planning regions). No renaming or case-folding is applied to the key. Each entry also carries 'lookup_key' (lower-case, periods and apostrophes removed, whitespace collapsed) and 'lookup_key_short' (same, with a trailing County/Parish/Borough/Census Area/Municipality/City and Borough/Planning Region suffix removed) for dropdown and free-text matching.
_meta.units: 1/2/3/4 = number of dwelling units; values are USD
_meta.note: PARTIAL COVERAGE - see limits_coverage_report.md. County names are taken from the FHFA official county list joined on FIPS code, because the HUD flat file truncates county names to 15 characters.
